```yaml
name: PR Template Check

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  push:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run build
      - run: npm test

  publish_documentation_netlify:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: ${{ github.event_name == 'push' }}
    env:
      DRAFT_BUILD: ${{ github.ref != 'refs/heads/main' }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run build:docs
      - name: Deploy to Netlify
        env:
          NETLIFY_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NETLIFY_AUTH_TOKEN }}
          NETLIFY_SITE_ID: ${{ secrets.NETLIFY_SITE_ID }}
        run: |>
          curl -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d '{"files": {"index.html":"<html>...</html>"}}' \
            "https://api.netlify.com/api/v1/sites/${{ env.NETLIFY_SITE_ID }}/deploys?auth=${{ env.NETLIFY_AUTH_TOKEN }}"

  check_any_package:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Check any package
        id: check_any_package
        run: |
          echo "changed=$(git diff --name-only ${{ github.event.before }} ${{ github.sha }} | grep '^packages/' | wc -l)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
```
